page: Microsoft Azure EC8eds_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEDV5 server family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture and is powered by an Intel processor. The system is provisioned with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration includes 232 GB of local storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any integrated GPUs, making it a CPU-only compute node. Additionally, the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the EC8eds_v5 offers a qualitative balance of high memory capacity and dedicated CPU allocation, which is typical of memory-optimized hardware classes. This configuration is designed for workloads requiring significant memory overhead relative to compute cores, such as relational databases, in-memory caching layers, and enterprise applications.
